description:
“Just like my sisters, I’ll seduce men and wrap them around my little finger—one by one!”

Long ago, in an age of myths and mountains, a family of gumiho sisters thrived by charming travelers and stealing their essence. Life was sweet—until the youngest, Arang, suddenly declares she’s heading to the human world to seduce a man of her own. Mischievous, naïve, and fiercely determined, Arang is ready to unleash her foxy charm. But in the world of humans, love doesn’t always follow the rules of magic... and this little fox might just get caught in her own trap.

**Original Webtoon:**
